units.source_text: 槿姬听到世间传说源氏公子是个薄情郎，于是主意坚定，决心不效别人那样受他的诱惑。

en.t: Lady Asagao heard the world say that Prince Genji was a heartless lover, so she made up her mind firmly and resolved not to be tempted by him as others had been.

units.source_text: 公子给她信，她大都置之不答，不过难得回他一封短书。

en.t: When the prince sent her letters, she usually left them unanswered, though on rare occasions she would send him a brief note in reply.

units.source_text: 然而也不表示嫌恶，使他难堪。

en.t: Yet she did not show dislike or make him feel awkward.

units.source_text: 因此源氏公子始终认为这个人是优异的。

en.t: For that reason, Prince Genji always considered her an exceptional person.
